title: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP)

source.title: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP) - India

note: Retrieved 2026-10-17 from the World Bank API. Fiscal-year labelling as for gdp-usd. Official MoSPI National Accounts shares of manufacturing in GVA differ (about 17-18% at constant 2011-12 prices per Rajya Sabha replies and press reports) because of price basis and GDP-vs-GVA definitions; the 25% target does not specify the basis, so both are shown in the claim evidence.
